## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle anonymous Chinese translation of the same discourse rendered in [T134](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0134). T134 and T135 are two near-identical recensions of the *Five Merit-Rewards* discourse, printed by the Taishō as T132a and T132b. The alternative title 佛說施色力經 (preserved in the source rubric) reflects the discourse's connection between food-giving and the granting of beauty (色) and strength (力).

**Abstract**

The Eastern Jìn (317–420) ascription is a catalog-tradition assignment. The defensible bracket is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
